sections.title: Findings
sections.text: F1 low, owner P8.2, packages/skiller/lib/skiller/connect.py:236 and packages/skiller/lib/skiller/connect.py:183: the Resident estimate recognizes module plugins only through host_expansion. Direct selection through --plugins or [skiller].plugins produces an empty host_expansion, so module skills are counted as a nonexistent library bucket. Throwaway synthetic HostCase reproduction: prepare_connect_selection with plugins=mod-a, no_core=true, then _do_connect_claude(list=true, register=false) prints Plugins: mod-a and Resident: ~0 ... (0 skills). _resident_tokens(env, [mod-a], {mod-a}) reports 7 tier-0 tokens and 1 skill for the same source. This affects the pre-connect estimate; it does not prevent delivery or invalidate the separate budget report. Reproduction completed with exit 0 and cleaned up its temporary project and sandbox HOME.

sections.title: Evidence and reuse boundary
sections.text: Plan check: 0 errors, 2 historical modify_missing warnings (the removed plugins.py re-export and moved system/local-topology skill). P8.1-P8.6 results and P8 journal deviations were inspected. Reused P8.7 V1-V6 recorded exit 0 at 2026-10-09T16:09:33Z: the only later candidate commit ba372832 changes log.jsonl and P8 execution records, with no product/test/tool/config delta after those checks. No broad replay. Reused the prior Grok GREEN correction review of P8.1/P8.2 without repeating its resolved findings. Source inspection covered skiller imports/launchers/standalone foundation_free, module source containment and aliases, both marketplaces and moved skills, connect/vendor/sync/status integration, selection/sync section precedence, writers and shared backups, describe/index metadata, ADR 0049-0051 and recorded E27/R44/R59 reconciliation. P8.3/P8.4 e2e checks cover both legacy JSON and TOML configurations. The first-turn value 2464 is a managed estimate; the journal explicitly reports unavailable native plugin inventory and an additional module plugin estimate of approximately 1.3K, rather than a measured native plugin total. This limitation is retained, not promoted into a demonstrated defect. Live remote refresh during audit: git fetch -q origin succeeded and origin/ecosystem-split...HEAD was 0 behind / 0 ahead before audit publication. The committed P8.7 Blocked result therefore records a historical push boundary, not a currently demonstrated unsent product commit.

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.text: For F1, the owning P8.2 correction should derive recognized module plugins from module_skill_sources(env), including direct selections, and validate the direct --plugins and config.plugins cases alongside host-bucket expansion. No full-phase rerun is warranted for a reporting-only correction. P8.7 owner/executor may reconcile its historical push-only Blocked result after the live V7 gate; audit does not rewrite execution state. Product docs and CHANGELOG need no update for this audit-only artifact. The semantic Next is reported separately through plan.py next.
